messages:
maria: Heads up — vendor flagged a partial depot clearance hold in Rotterdam. ~12 racks on HOLD due to paperwork mismatch, affects our EU Dedicated commit for ACME. No firm ETA yet.
logistics-bot: Shipment 9GHT-443 status -> HOLD. Reason: missing EORI/BOL match. First noticed 2024-11-02 04:12 UTC. Docs link: https://vendor-portal.example/9GHT-443
devon: Ok. Can we triage: which racks are critical for Q2 customer lanes vs which can be returned to marketplace inventory? Need a fallback plan. @sam-partner any immediate options? :thinking_face:
sam-partner: Sorry about the hold — customs flagged an invoice EORI mismatch. We can either amend docs (needs Redwood sign-off) or release a subset on expedited clearance. I can push 4 racks for priority release if we sign the amendment attachment I send. ETA for those ~24-48h after sign.
charlie: If we push 4 racks, can infra route those to the dedicated pool without re-provisioning? What's the SKU parity vs our EU pool? Latency-sensitive apps may be impacted if we shift region.
anya: Heads-up from customer side: ACME expects full commit for launch next week. If we can't deliver, we'll need to offer credits or temporary uplift elsewhere. We should avoid a public joint announcement until resolved.
devon: Proposed quick plan: 1) Ask vendor to expedite 4 racks (priority) 2) Reassign remaining 8 racks to marketplace/fallback to keep other customers running 3) Notify ACME + offer uplift from US-WEST pool and a one-time credit. Owners: devon (partner negotiation), maria (customer comms), charlie (routing), finance to calc credit. Thoughts?
maria: Works for me. I'll draft a short customer note and ping legal on the amendment. Can we get the marketplace reassign step pre-authorized so we can flip fast?
alex: For infra ops, use reserve-manager. Example command to move inventory: `reserve-manager reassign --from=EU-ROT --to=marketplace-eu --count=8 --reason="customs-hold"` will create a pending change that needs approvals. Also see internal playbook: https://redwood.infra/docs/reserve-playbook#marketplace-fallback
sam-partner: Sending amendment and manifest split now. I can mark racks 1-4 as high-priority and request customs manual clearance. Need PO ref and EORI confirmation from Redwood to proceed.
maria: PO ref 2024-ACME-6789 and EORI XXXXX12345 — I'll send signed attachment today EOD. devon, will you confirm the reassignment approval window for marketplace so we can execute once vendor confirms?
devon: I'll approve marketplace reassign as soon as we have vendor confirmation. Charlie, can you stand by for routing changes?
charlie: Standing by. If we route to US-WEST we'll hot-route traffic for latency-sensitive routes and add a note in the console dashboard. Expect a ~6-12% p99 latency bump but we'll monitor.
anya: I'll prepare the ACME comms with optional uplift offer + credit language. Keep me in the loop on the confirmed rack count.
maria: thanks everyone. Will update this thread when signed and when vendor confirms expedited release. :white_check_mark:
